notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that can prevent the user from switching melee weapons.
[*]Improved camera tracking to reduce the chances of motion sickness.
[/list]

notes.title: Savegame Protection Update
notes.notes: Fixed a rare issue where the sequence CONTINUE->QUIT->START->QUIT->CONTINUE will reset the savegame's difficulty mode and collected placards.

notes.title: Crosshair Animation Fix
notes.notes: Fixed the crosshair animation not resetting when a lock-on is cancelled manually.

notes.title: UI and Game Balance Updates
notes.notes:
New features:

[list]
[*] Weapon selection wheel
[*] Objective cues
[*] More achievements
[*] In-game strategy guide
[*] Spanish localization
[*] Beginner-friendly gameplay tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: French Localization
notes.notes: Added French to the language selection.

notes.title: Remembrance Day Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added region detection that automatically chooses one of the supported languages at startup.
[*] Improved UI scaling to keep text and images fully inside non-16:9 displays.
[/list]

notes.title: Resoultion Selector and Improved Textures
notes.notes: No more messing with the command line.

notes.title: Feature Updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] An easy mode that gives the player greater combat abilities and endless time in exchange for 25% less scoring.
[*] Steam Cloud saving.
[*] Steam Cloud leaderboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Stability and Frame-Pacing Updates
notes.notes: Less lag and stuttering!

notes.title: Graphic Workload Reduction
notes.notes: GPU demand has been lessened by 15-20% with no performance loss, lowering the chance of device overheating in the summer.

notes.title: Extended Gamepad Rumbling
notes.notes: Better haptic feedback that increases immersion.

notes.title: Achievement Expansion
notes.notes: It's Canada Day!

notes.title: System and Game Mechanic Updates
notes.notes: Apart from stability improvements, melee weapons are given a boost against drivers. Be watchful, for the enemies may sneak up on you.

notes.title: Duplicate Item Fix Redeploy
notes.notes: Previous attempt interrupted due to network congestion.

notes.title: Duplicate Item Fix
notes.notes: Resolved an issue that causes items to spawn more than once.

notes.title: NPC AI Update
notes.notes: Addressed a few unusual situations where an NPC may get stuck during heavy battles.

notes.title: Long-Distance Respawn
notes.notes: Respawning from a very long distance is much better handled with this update.

notes.title: Clearer Mission Objectives
notes.notes: Players will be reminded of their immediate goals periodically if no progress has been made.

notes.title: Game Saving Protection from Accidental Shutdown
notes.notes: Power outage is beyond the player's control sometimes. This update makes sure your progress is saved in its entirety instantly.

notes.title: More Achievements and Player-Friendly Features
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Extra achievements can be earned by reaching different milestones.
[*] The game now reminds you when you wander off-course into dangerous territories. 
[/list]

notes.title: Penguin's Road Works Great on the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Designed from the start to play flawlessly on the Steam Deck

notes.title: Easier Menu Navigation on a Keyboard
notes.notes:
Players can now navigate the game menus on a keyboard in different ways:

1. ASDW + Space Bar
2. Arrows + Enter
3. Numeric Arrows + Numeric Enter
